backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a task management system with functions to add, remove, toggle completion status, update text, and retrieve all tasks stored in a Map keyed by task text.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: a dark mode toggle button in the application header and localStorage persistence for dark mode preference across sessions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing summaries of frontend files including React Query hooks, todo components, dark mode toggle, passive-aggressive modal, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes using warm earth tones, avoiding blue and purple colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with inline script that applies dark mode class from localStorage before React loads to prevent flash of unstyled content.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component rendering the todo list interface with header (including dark mode toggle), task input section, task list, and footer with caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/DarkModeToggle.t: Toggle button component that switches between light and dark modes with localStorage persistence, displaying sun/moon icons based on current theme state.
frontend/src/components/PassiveAggressiv: Dialog modal component that displays a randomly selected passive-aggressive message from 15 options when a task is unchecked.
frontend/src/components/TodoInput.tsx: Input form component for adding new tasks with text input, submit button, and loading state during task creation via React Query mutation.
frontend/src/components/TodoList.tsx: Task list component displaying all tasks with checkboxes for completion toggling, inline edit mode with save/cancel controls, and triggers passive-aggressive modal when tasks are unchecked.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with idle handling options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for task operations: fetching all tasks, adding tasks, toggling task completion, and updating task text. Each mutation invalidates the tasks query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earth-tone color palette for both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (using OKLCH), border radius variables, typography, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features for a daily todo list app with passive-aggressive behavior when tasks are unchecked, including task management, styling, dark mode, and edit functionality.
